summary: Trinity Capital Inc. filed an 8-K to report the issuance and sale of $300 million aggregate principal amount of its 7.000% Notes due 2031, entered into via an underwriting agreement with Keefe, Bruyette & Woods and MUFG Securities Americas Inc. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, maturing May 21, 2031, with semi-annual interest. The filing also includes an eighth supplemental indenture with the trustee. This is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
